indicators.label: Delivery balance (up days vs down days)
Delivery % trend vs own baseline
indicators.rule: A above +3 pp, D below -3 pp

indicators.label: Delivery spike persistence
indicators.rule: persistent when at least 3 spike days and a spike-day rate at least 1.5x the baseline; A when spike days on up days are at least 2x those on down days, D for the reverse

indicators.label: Named deals, FII + DII net (bulk and block)
indicators.rule: A above +10 Cr, D below -10 Cr of FII + DII net value via bulk and block deals over the window (round trips excluded); null before the deal history

indicators.label: FII + DII holdings change, last two quarters
indicators.rule: A above +0.5 pp, D below -0.5 pp of FII + DII holdings over the last two quarters (a filing counts from its broadcast day); null when a base quarter is not filed

indicators.label: Promoter holdings change, last two quarters
indicators.rule: A above +0.5 pp, D below -0.5 pp of promoter holdings over the last two quarters (promoter selling is D); null when a base quarter is not filed

label: Evidence summary, not advice. You decide. Historical, one sample period, today's index membership (survivorship bias), before costs. Not a prediction.

dealsNet.note: Rs Cr of FII + DII net value via bulk and block deals over the window; round trips excluded (07 6A, Phase 4)
